title: Rietveld Schröder House
scope: Restored exterior of the Rietveld Schröder House in Utrecht with all three outward elevations, attached party wall, distinct balcony planes and primary-colour steelwork.
limitations: The model covers the restored exterior. It leaves out interior partitions, furnishings, the adjacent terrace house and the visitor centre.
Main painted planes and primary-colour accents follow the cleared colour photograph. The less photographed garden return and exact glazing reflectance are approximate.
